description: List the third-party apps the user has connected to their Agentcard account via OAuth (e.g. Kilo), including when each was connected and whether it is still active. Read-only. To revoke an app, call revoke_connection with its clientId.
name: list_connections

connections.description: The third-party apps connected to the user's account via OAuth.

active.description: Whether the connection is still active.

clientId.description: The OAuth client ID of the connected app.

clientName.description: The display name of the connected app, or null if unnamed.

connectedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the app was first connected.

lastTokenAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent token issued to the app.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes granted to the app.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the connected apps.

status.description: Result status: "no_connections" when none are connected, otherwise "ok".
